editionLabel: Rio Grande Games English rules, 2016 release
firstPlayerRule: The first player to make a trumpet sound and announce themselves as the starting player starts.
clarifications: That player places a character first; other players place characters clockwise.
Regular turns then begin with the same starting player and continue clockwise.
